messages.author: 3cd05f7c9e5494f9
messages.subject: difficulties installing aroma.affymetrix
parts:
Hi everybody,
I am trying to install aroma.affymetrix on Mac OS X, but the program
gives me the following error message and then R freezes (attached as
screenshot, as I cannot copy from the frozen window).

In brief, there seems to be some problem with the version of R and a
certain 'lib' configuration.

Can anyone make sense of this?

Thank you,

Ingo

messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] difficulties installing aroma.affymetrix
parts:
Ingo.

The 'lib' is just a warning and all it means is you haven't specified
a particular directory to install it in, so it goes to a default. I
get the same message.

Is your connection to CRAN working? It seems to be working for me as
below .....


> source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")

01/02. digest: v0.3.0, i.e. up to date.

date. Updating:

"mac.binary", :

= dependencies, :

Mark

parts:
Hi Ingo.

The package recommends 1.5G RAM (my Mac has 2Gb and it seems to work
well). But, most of the work can be done in <500Mb. And, you can
specify it to use less memory if necessary.

Have you been able to install it? Or, does it still hang?

Can you do a 'sessionInfo()' for us? For example, my mac gives
(after loading aroma.affymetrix):

Cheers,
Mark
